pool.text: On June 1, the town of Kansas was officially incorporated in the area.
The city was reincorporated and renamed City of Kansas on March 28.
The evening paper was first published by William Rockhill Nelson and his partner.
The municipality was officially renamed as Kansas City during this year.
Kansas City hosted the Democratic National Convention during this year.
The 8th Street Tunnel was constructed as an underground streetcar system.
Radio station signed on as an affiliate of the NBC Red Network.
Kansas City hosted the Republican National Convention during this year.
Jess and Jim's Steakhouse was founded in the Martin City neighborhood.
The Star signed on a television network affiliate station during this year.
Kansas City became a major league city when a baseball franchise relocated.
The Kansas City Ballet was founded by Tatiana Dokoudovska as a troupe.
Lyric Opera of Kansas City was founded to perform at the center.
The franchise started play as the Dallas Texans of the football league.
The professional football team moved its operations to Kansas City.
The transit authority was formed via a bi-state compact created by legislatures.
The team became the last AFL champion and won Super Bowl IV.
The city's current Major League Baseball franchise, the Royals, started play.
The National Hockey League placed an expansion team in Kansas City called the Scouts.
The park and boulevard system was recognized as a National Historic Landmark.
